push.title: W 1-0 vs Tøken FC | You: 8.4
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.4 for a forward. Better than most. Not your ceiling, though, not by a long shot.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Tøken FC's goal. Volume creates chances, and you created plenty.
+ 2 key passes. You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ Man of the Match, your 22nd for us. That's leadership you can't fake.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 2. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Bottle that and bring it next match.

THE BAD
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Pro tip: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 1. Let's turn that around by next session.
- shot selection got you and PhogsToffees. Communicate and cut it back to each other.
- Pass accuracy: 85%. Top-quarter forwards live at 88%+. Let's move in.
- Match rating 8.4, from 10.0 in your previous match. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.

Work on: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: A goal is just a pass to the net.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 1-0 vs Tøken FC | You: 7.1
push.body:
A 7.1, PhogsToffees. Rough patch. But you know what grows in rough patches? Wildflowers.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Tøken FC's goal. That's an attacking mindset.
+ 1 assist (down from your usual 2). Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ You and BellyTb1 were a two-person band and the crowd loved it.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (7.1 vs their best 6.4). That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (24 vs their best 14). Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- 73% passing (24 of 33). Small change, big gain: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy. Simple as Sunday.
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Bread and butter: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Water the plant.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. That needs to look different next time out.
- You and BellyTb1 share this one: shot selection. Tandem fix: cut it back to each other.
- Match rating 7.1, down from your usual 8.4. That's not a crisis, but it's a warning light.

Fundamentals drill: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

Don't be hard on yourself; be honest with yourself. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 1-0 vs Tøken FC | You: 6.5 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 3rd best match performance of the season, Soup_Kitchen22, with a 6.5. Let's push it up the list.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Tøken FC's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 2 key passes, the most you've made for us. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ Completed passes 12, up from your usual 7. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Tackles attempted 8, up from your usual 4. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ You saw BellyTb1's run before BellyTb1 did.

THE BAD
- 67% passing (12 of 18, up from your usual 56%). Lesson of the day: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Habits beat highlights.
- Won 0 of 8 tackles (down from your usual 28%). Start here: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 6.5 (best was BellyTb1's 8.4). We can fix that.

THE UGLY
! 0 goals from 2 on target. A low point, and a clear one. Clear is good: it means we know where to start. Quick one: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.

Training-ground special: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.

One thought for the road, Soup_Kitchen22: Taking on a challenge is a lot like riding a horse. Comfortable is overrated.

Stay curious about your game. - Coach Lasso
